system.description: You trap a willing or defeated ghost inside an object, such as a gem, a weapon or a lantern.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the ghost is content and will never turn on you.
outcomes.success: The object becomes a Relic with one power that suits the ghost's nature (a Vengeful Dagger might deal extra damage; a Scholar's Lantern might read any language).
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the ghost slips away.
outcomes.ruin: The ghost is bound to you instead of the object, and it is not happy about it. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
